description: BST-1065 vector-parity regression fixture. Captured from @huggingface/transformers 4.2.0 (the version already in use on main at capture time) using the feature-extraction pipeline on the CPU/fp32 execution provider under plain Node (no WebGPU in Node; the browser build calls this EP wasm, the Node build calls it cpu). Verified byte-for-byte-equivalent (cosine similarity 1.000000 on every item) against a fresh isolated install of @huggingface/transformers 3.8.1, the last pre-v4 version this repo ran (see docs in the PR description for how that comparison was performed). This fixture guards against silent embedding-quality regressions on future major-version bumps of the library.
